enunciado: A Thermometer (subject) notifies its observers whenever the temperature changes: a Display that shows it and an Alarm that only reacts above a limit. Observers are kept in a linked list. Change the temperature to 22, 31 and 18.
objetivos: Decouple who produces events from who reacts
Keep a collection of objects with a linked list
pistas: Observer is an interface with update(temperature).
subscribe adds a node at the head of the list.
Class attributes cannot be arrays: hence the linked list.
